sentences.en: Most cultures around the world today are monogamous.
sentences.zh: 当今世界上大多数文化都是一夫一妻制的。

sentences.en: In a monogamous relationship, both partners commit to each other exclusively.
sentences.zh: 在一对一的关系中，双方都会彼此忠诚地承诺给对方。

sentences.en: Many animals are not monogamous like humans and form multiple relationships.
sentences.zh: 许多动物不像人类一样是一夫一妻制的，它们会形成多个关系。

senses.zh: 一夫一妻的，单配的，一雌一雄的
